description: Binary assertions for /helix-embody-realize v3.1 multi-agent pipeline orchestration
test_input: embody concept A for VN-AST-MSL-001 towed sea target

assertions.name: pipeline_orchestration
assertions.check: output follows pipeline structure with CEO checkpoints

assertions.name: block_preflight
assertions.check: output includes preflight with embodiment-determining requirements

assertions.name: block_layout
assertions.check: output acknowledges layout as CEO Core judgment

assertions.name: block_dfx
assertions.check: output contains DfX review with DfM, DfA, DfT minimum
assertions.regex: DfX|DfM|DfA|DfT|Design for Manufacture|Design for Assembly|Design for Test

assertions.name: dfu_present
assertions.check: output includes DfU or explicitly states N/A for mechanical-only

assertions.name: basic_rules_audit
assertions.check: output checks 3 basic rules (Clarity, Simplicity, Safety)

assertions.name: block_integrate
assertions.check: output contains integration check and ICD v3

assertions.name: block_compile
assertions.check: output includes evaluation (Rt/Re) and Gate 3 reference

assertions.name: ceo_checkpoints
assertions.check: output includes CEO approve/adjust/pause after blocks

assertions.name: maritime_awareness
assertions.check: output mentions P50/P51 or maritime mode

assertions.name: design_principles
assertions.check: output checks 5 design principles (force transmission, division, self-help, stability, fault-free)
